children.name: Berberidopsis beckleri  Veldkamp
children.description: Berberidopsis beckleri is a species of climbing plant found in cool rainforests in eastern Australia.

children.name: Streptothamnus moorei F.Muell.
children.description: The single accepted species of the genus Streptothamnus in the small family Berberidopsidaceae (order Berberidopsidales). It is a scandent (climbing) shrub of forested montane areas, native to northern New South Wales and southeast Queensland, Australia. Its wood anatomy supports the genus's placement in Berberidopsidales alongside Aextoxicaceae.
